sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Star Pendant Necklace in Gold Finish
sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of celestial charm to your look with our Cut-out Star Pendant Necklace. This dainty, gold-toned piece is designed for the modern trendsetter, offering a chic and lightweight aesthetic that's perfect for layering or wearing solo as a fashion statement. To ensure your stars stay shining bright, we recommend keeping this fashionable piece away from moisture and storing it in a dry place after use.
